proof_scope: deterministic chunk extraction from a bundled mini OpenAPI spec, fail-closed interview gating, and a live memory-daemon ingest+recall round-trip when the daemon is reachable

claims.proves: the skill extracts Q-A chunks through its real CLI, fails closed with a NEEDS_INTERVIEW packet on missing required config, and can ingest a fixture KB into /memory and recall it through the live daemon
claims.does_not_prove: arbitrary client corpora, docs fetching (delegated to fetcher/brave-search), Qdrant semantic ranking quality, or live-evidence UI rendering of the cards

cases.name: live-verify-recall-drivewealth-e2e
command: if ! curl -s -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8601/health >/dev/null; then echo 'probes SKIP daemon-unreachable'; exit 0; fi; ../run.sh verify --config ../configs/drivewealth.yaml
